name: PICTON Investments
verdict: Owned by its employees - Picton Mahoney Asset Management is 100% employee-owned. Nothing found.
note: Front-of-jersey sponsor of Rugby Canada's men's and women's national teams through 2027 (Rugby Canada announcement, 30 June 2026). Canadian investment firm with CAD 17.3bn under management (March 2026, per its own release); no human-rights findings found against the firm.
